title: Returns for unopened products
content: An unopened product may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery. Proof of purchase is required. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after the returned item is inspected.

title: Opened and defective products
content: Opened products cannot be returned for a change of mind. A defective product may be reported within 30 calendar days of delivery. Support will assess the defect and arrange a replacement or refund if the claim is approved.

title: Shipping coverage and delivery
content: Shipping is available within Malaysia only. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Shipping is free for orders of RM150 or more; otherwise the shipping fee is RM8.

title: Duplicate billing
content: For a suspected duplicate charge, contact billing support with the order ID and the dates and amounts of the charges. Do not send a full card number or card security code. Billing support responds within 2 business days. A response is not a guarantee that a refund has been approved.

title: Support availability
content: General support is available Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm Malaysia time, excluding public holidays. Contact support through the customer portal. The knowledge base does not specify a telephone number.

title: Order cancellation
content: An order can be cancelled through the customer portal before dispatch. After dispatch, cancellation is unavailable and the applicable returns policy must be followed.
